title: Genie: enhanced agentic RAG over policy documents
problem: An on-call Slack copilot answered security and privacy questions inaccurately over 40+ policy documents; a golden set of 100+ expert questions showed answers were incomplete or wrong.
depth: Detailed pipeline and evaluation method; relative improvements only
facts: A custom Google Docs loader replaced PDF parsing because standard PDF loaders lost table structure and no single parser worked across documents.
An LLM converts tables and structured text to markdown; table chunks are kept intact via metadata; documents get LLM summaries and chunks get FAQs and keywords.
Pre-retrieval agents rewrite ambiguous queries, split complex ones into sub-queries and identify the most likely source documents.
Retrieval runs vector search and BM25 over enriched metadata and merges results as a union; a post-processor deduplicates and orders chunks by position in the source.
Evaluation uses expert reference answers run in batch with an LLM judge scoring 0-5, cutting evaluation turnaround from weeks to minutes.
Reported results are relative: 27% more acceptable answers and 60% fewer incorrect answers.
interpretations: Changing the source format (Google Docs instead of PDF) was a bigger lever than changing the model, which is a common ingestion lesson.
Relative gains without baselines cannot be converted to absolute quality; ask for the baseline before quoting these numbers to a client.

decisions.selected: Custom Google Docs loader with table-aware markdown conversion
decisions.alternatives: Keep PDF parsers (several tried); OCR or layout models; re-author sources
decisions.reasoning: Source documents PDF parsers losing table row and column context and no universal parser.

decisions.selected: Hybrid vector plus BM25 union over enriched metadata
decisions.alternatives: Vector only; BM25 only; reranker-based fusion
decisions.reasoning: Source describes the hybrid; the choice of union over reranking is not explained.

decisions.selected: Query optimizer and source identifier agents before retrieval
decisions.reasoning: Source describes the agents as handling ambiguity and narrowing sources.

decisions.selected: Expert references plus LLM judge with reasoning
decisions.alternatives: Human review per release; synthetic questions only
decisions.reasoning: Source cites speed gain. Judge validity is not reported.

review_exercise: The reported 60% reduction in incorrect advice has no baseline. Define the evidence you would request, and how you would test the judge's agreement with experts before trusting it.
lessons: Enrich chunks and queries; do not rely on raw similarity alone.
Judge-based evaluation speeds iteration but must be validated against humans.
adaptation: For an SAP service knowledge assistant over product manuals and notes, the same ingestion-first approach applies; the access-control question (not answered in the source) must be designed explicitly. Independent analysis.
